rule: A team must receive a warning if it registers two players with the same bib number.
incident: The team registered two players with bib number 12.

rule: A team must receive a warning if it submits a roster without a captain's signature.
incident: The team turned in a roster with the captain's signature line blank.

rule: A team must receive a warning if it uses a shortened team name on the entry form.
incident: The team entered only its initial in the full-name box.

rule: A team must receive a warning if it lists more than eight players on its match entry.
incident: The team listed nine players on its match entry.

rule: A team must receive a warning if it leaves a round score blank on the match report.
incident: The team submitted its match report with the second round score blank.

rule: A team must receive a warning if it gives a final score verbally instead of using the report slip.
incident: The team told the scorekeeper the final score and submitted no slip.

rule: A team must receive a warning if it files a score correction without the match number.
incident: The team sent a score correction with no match number.

rule: A team must receive a warning if it records an exhibition point in the league total.
incident: The team added a point from the exhibition round to its league total.

rule: A team must receive a warning if it starts a practice drill before the opening bell.
incident: The team started a passing drill before the bell rang.

rule: A team must receive a warning if it takes more than two minutes for a scheduled water break.
incident: The team took three minutes for its scheduled water break.

rule: A team must receive a warning if it continues a warmup after the warmup timer sounds.
incident: The team kept warming up for twenty seconds after the timer sounded.

rule: A team must receive a warning if it arrives at the lineup mark after the five-minute call.
incident: The team reached the lineup mark one minute after the five-minute call.

rule: A team must receive a warning if it brings a match ball to the field without a current inspection sticker.
incident: The team brought a ball to the field with last week's inspection sticker.

rule: A team must receive a warning if it skips the count of its practice cones at check-in.
incident: The team carried its cones past the check-in desk without having them counted.

rule: A team must receive a warning if it sends a measuring tape to inspection without a readable scale.
incident: The team presented a tape with the scale rubbed off.

rule: A team must receive a warning if its equipment case has no team tag at inspection.
incident: The team presented an equipment case with no tag.

rule: A team must receive a warning if it puts its kit bags outside its marked storage area.
incident: The team left its kit bags beside the bench, outside the marked area.

rule: A team must receive a warning if it wheels its kit cart through the spectator entrance.
incident: The team brought its kit cart in through the spectator entrance.

rule: A team must receive a warning if it leaves the bench area without erasing its notes from the shared board.
incident: The team left its bench area with its notes still on the shared board.

rule: A team must receive a warning if it sets its team sign on the officials' table.
incident: The team put its sign on the officials' table.

rule: A team must receive a warning if its substitute enters before the outgoing player leaves the field.
incident: The team's substitute stepped onto the field while the outgoing player was still on it.

rule: A team must receive a warning if it requests a substitution without handing over the blue card.
incident: The team requested a substitution by raising a hand and did not hand over a card.

rule: A team must receive a warning if its substitute enters from the end line.
incident: The team's substitute entered from the end line beside the flag.

rule: A team must receive a warning if it makes a third substitution in a period.
incident: The team made three substitutions in the first period.
